cflimit.upload: Uploads: up to {mb} MB per file (Cloudflare {plan})
cflimit.detail: Cloudflare refuses larger uploads at its edge with error 413, so the app never sees them. Business allows 200 MB, Enterprise 500 MB. For large files use the private network (NetBird or Tailscale) or the local network
cflimit.label: Cloudflare upload limit
lanswitch.label: Offer the local network address
lanswitch.detail: Off by default. When on, a page opened through Cloudflare (own domain, Free link or temporary address) checks from the visitor's own browser whether it reaches DSM directly on the local network, and only then offers DSM's local address. The visitor signs in again there; with HTTPS, the browser warns about DSM's own certificate. The check uses TCP port {port}: if the DSM firewall is on, allow it from the local network
lanswitch.unavailable: Another app uses the check's port, so the local network is not offered
lanswitch.unsaved: The setting could not be saved
lanswitch.found: DSM is on your local network
lanswitch.signin: Its local address is faster than going through Cloudflare. You sign in again there.
lanswitch.certificate: The browser warns about DSM's own certificate: choose Advanced, then continue.
lanswitch.open: Open DSM on the local network
